_comment: Performance plan section B. FREE-tier workloads only (P0). Shared with the Rust harness so both clients run identical requests. Dates stay inside the documented FREE window (from 2023-06-01).

W1.description: Bulk stock EOD backfill: one year for ten liquid symbols, one request per symbol.

W2.description: Option chain EOD for one day: every SPY contract (all expirations) on 2024-06-14. The expiration wildcard is unverified; W2b is the fallback.

W2b.description: Option chain EOD for one day and one expiration: SPY 2024-06-21 on 2024-06-14 (fallback if the expiration wildcard is rejected).
